params.1266: Shellfish Roasting on an Open Fire
params.1274: Acquire a crayfish (you can get one by fishing with a crayfish cage).
params.1275: Lumbridge's fishing shop can give you a cage.
params.1276: Light a log fire or find a cooking range.
params.1277: Click on the crayfish to select it, then use it on the fire or range.
params.1278: You may accidentally burn it, so bring several.
params.2225: You can eat food to heal wounds sustained in combat. At higher Cooking levels you can cook more effective food types.
